title: Sticky notes
description: A pixel sticky-note board: add a note with text and one of 4 colors, notes can be edited in place and deleted, a counter shows the number of notes, and a Clear all button asks for confirmation.

title: Savings goal
description: A pixel savings planner: a goal amount, a monthly deposit and a yearly interest rate; show how many months until the goal is reached and the total interest earned, and a month-by-month table.

title: Whack-a-mole
description: A pixel whack-a-mole on a 3x3 grid: Start begins a 30-second round, a mole appears in a random hole every second, clicking it scores a point, show score and time left, and Game over at zero.

title: Playlist editor
description: A pixel playlist of 6 built-in songs with durations: move songs up and down, remove them, a Shuffle button, and show the number of songs and the total length as h:mm:ss.

title: Thermostat
description: A pixel thermostat: plus and minus buttons change the target from 10 to 30 degrees in steps of 0.5, a mode selector Heat, Cool or Off, and a status line saying whether it is heating, cooling or idle against a fixed room temperature of 21.

title: Parking lot
description: A pixel parking lot with 12 numbered spaces: click a free space to park a car with a typed plate, click an occupied one to remove it, show free and occupied counts, and a search box that highlights a plate.

title: Spelling bee
description: A pixel spelling game with 6 built-in words shown as scrambled letters: the player types the word, Check says correct or wrong, a Next button moves on, and the score is shown at the end.

title: Fraction calculator
description: A pixel fraction calculator: two fractions with numerator and denominator inputs, + − × ÷ buttons, the result in lowest terms and as a decimal to three places, and an error for a zero denominator.
